name: Sallai
overview: The name Sallai, also rendered as Sallu, appears in the book of Nehemiah identifying a Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem and a priest who returned with Zerubbabel to rebuild the temple community. Nehemiah 11:8 lists Sallai among the inhabitants of Jerusalem, emphasizing his role as part of the restored city. Additionally, Nehemiah 12:7 and 12:20 highlight Sallai as a chief priest, signifying his importance in the priestly leadership during the days of Jeshua. These references collectively show Sallai's dual identity as both a faithful layman and a spiritual leader in the post-exilic community.
